title: Within-patient QTcF analysis of MIMIC-IV with prespecified negative controls
description: Code, nonidentifying aggregate results, publication figures, and reporting documentation supporting a within-patient analysis of drug-associated QTcF differences in critically ill adults. Patient-level and stay-level MIMIC-derived data are excluded under PhysioNet access restrictions.
data_access_note: MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-IV-ECG source data and all patient-level derivatives require PhysioNet credentialing and are not included.
